# Interface example: what contract-terms writes

<!-- Generated by spike/render_interface_example.py from spike/out/*.json. Do not edit by hand. Rerun spike/contract_terms_spike.py, then the renderer. -->

This feature has no screen of its own. Its interface is what it adds to `out/<room>/redflags.json`: claims, gaps, and two Panels, "contract terms" and "contract checks". The readout, the memo and the ask list read them. So the prototype is this page: the real output of `scans.redflags.contract_terms_full.check` on the rooms and on made-up test contracts, written by [spike/contract_terms_spike.py](spike/contract_terms_spike.py). Every quote below was checked by `schema/check_quotes.py` in the same run; the count of failures is shown for each run.

Claim ids are the run's own (`redflags-NNN`, counted inside this check only).
